# Threshold Image Filter

Set image values to a user-specified "outside" value if they fall outside a threshold range.

## Group (Subgroup)

ImageProcessing (Thresholding)

## Description

Values within the closed range [Lower, Upper] pass through unchanged; values below Lower or above
Upper are set to the Outside Value. This is the ITK-free, out-of-core-capable reimplementation of
the legacy ITK Threshold Image Filter.
